thesis: The strongest short thesis is a value trap: PayPal can look optically cheap while branded checkout loses strategic relevance to Apple Pay, Shop Pay, Stripe and card-network tokenization. Q2 revenue/TPV grew, but active accounts were flat and transaction-margin-dollar growth was only low single digits. Still, the low valuation, strong FCF, net cash and aggressive share-count reduction prevent any exact Hard Veto from being established.

evidence.claim: Q2 active accounts were 439M and essentially flat sequentially.
Q2 transaction-margin dollars grew only 1%, or 3% excluding interest on customer balances.

counterevidence: Management said branded checkout further stabilized.
falsifiers: Sustained transaction-margin-dollar acceleration and branded checkout share stabilization weaken the short thesis; renewed share loss strengthens it.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: No restatement, auditor dispute or control failure is established.
Strong OCF and liquidity rebut structural dependence on outside capital.
Share count is shrinking rapidly through buybacks.
TPV, transactions and merchant utility show real customer value.
Strong FCF/share and low capital intensity do not establish structural incremental-ROIC collapse.
Competitive pressure is material but current data show stabilization rather than a documented continuing collapse.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current price is below Bear/Base/Bull DCF values.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성
hard_veto_flags.rationale: PayPal is diversified across branded checkout, Braintree, Venmo, credit and value-added services.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Cash flow and liquidity make bankruptcy or forced-financing risk remote relative to valuation upside.

next_checks: Q3 branded checkout, Venmo revenue, TM$, active accounts
